sql: SELECT meta_client_name, slot, slot_start_date_time, epoch, sumMerge(blocks) AS blocks, sumMerge(attestations) AS attestations FROM `glamsterdam-pbt-1`.beacon_api_slot WHERE meta_network_name='glamsterdam-pbt-1' AND slot_start_date_time >= '2026-10-25 08:00:00' AND slot_start_date_time < '2026-10-26 08:00:00' GROUP BY meta_client_name, slot, slot_start_date_time, epoch
